role: Static app FAQ/feature reference injected into the assistant's system prompt (full or compact, AIProvider+SystemPrompt.swift:140) and served section-by-section by the app.help.lookup fact tool (AppFactResolver+HealthKitFacts.swift:137).
types: AppKnowledgeBase: enum — holds reference/referenceCompact prompt text, help topic list and the lookup/extractSection functions
toplevel: reference and referenceCompact are multi-line string literals of product claims (tabs, recovery-score weights 60/25/15, SpO2 -10 penalty below 95%, Comeback 80/20/0 for 21 days, HR zones, exports, navigation paths, capabilities). helpTopics is declared but never read anywhere in the repo; the topic list is hard-coded again in the tool description at AppFactResolver+HealthKitFacts.swift:133.

flags.text: AppKnowledgeBase.helpTopics is never read (grep finds only its declaration); its doc says it is listed in the tool description, but that description hard-codes the same list separately, so the two can drift.

referenceCompact tells the model to call app.help.lookup for 'what's pNN50', but no section of reference mentions pNN50 (Metrics section lists RMSSD, SDNN, DFA, LF/HF, TRIMP, hrTSS, Pa:Hr, EF, HRR, METs, nocturnal dip), so the lookup returns no answer for that example.

units.does: Returns the app-reference section for a topic string: normalizes (lowercase, '-' and ' ' → '_', then trim whitespace), returns the full reference for 'all', the matching '## heading' section for a known alias, and referenceCompact for unknown topics or a missing heading. Called by the app.help.lookup fact (AppFactResolver+HealthKitFacts.swift:137).

branches.effect: fallback referenceCompact when the heading text is not found in reference

flags.text: Whitespace is trimmed after spaces were already converted to underscores, so the trim never removes spaces; a topic with surrounding spaces (' metrics ') becomes '_metrics_', misses topicHeadings and silently returns the compact reference instead of the section.

units.does: Scans reference line by line, starting capture at the first line beginning with '## '+heading and stopping at the next '## ' line; returns the captured block trimmed, or nil if the heading never appears.

branches.cond: already inside the section AND line starts with '## '
line starts with target heading (prefix match)

branches.effect: return nil; else return joined trimmed section
